name: NativeFinal.dot: classify terminal Float32 with existing inline self-BEq
NativeFinal.dot_eq: transport classifier premise through existing iff
before: have h := (dotLoop_eq n baseA baseB p A B 0 (Float32.ofBits 0) _ rfl hf).2
after:
have hnon := (R7W04.nonNaN_eq_true_iff _).mp hf
    have h := (dotLoop_eq n baseA baseB p A B 0 (Float32.ofBits 0) _ rfl hnon).2

name: Packed10.finish: same classifier as NativeFinal.dot
before:
def finish (n baseA baseB p : Nat) (Araw Braw : Array Binary32)
    (result : Float32) : Binary32 :=
  if hf : result.isNaN = false then ExecFloat.Binary.ofFloat32 result
  else R7NaNReplay.replayEarly n baseA baseB p Araw Braw
after:
def finish (n baseA baseB p : Nat) (Araw Braw : Array Binary32)
    (result : Float32) : Binary32 :=
  if hf : R7W04.nonNaN result = true then ExecFloat.Binary.ofFloat32 result
  else R7NaNReplay.replayEarly n baseA baseB p Araw Braw
